# Adversarial review — the reconcile digest fold under failure injection
Semantic pattern: **policy evaluation under injected corruption** -> visual type: **flowchart (attack lanes)** * verified at HEAD `156b7ee` * 1334 tests
▶ injected corruption digest fold ❌ stop point (fail-closed) ◆ observable outcome forged classification identity classification_id rewritten to FORGED in stored metadata classifications_digest D8 re-derivation of the identity ❌ silent recommendation BLOCKED — row surfaces as FORGED_IDENTITY error; integrity_status DEGRADED never a silent "no data" errors carry the code + artifact id ◆ FAIL-CLOSED * corrupt row is dropped from recommendations but explicitly represented in errors tamper: stored PENDING, gate False proposal stored PENDING non-authority action (gate False) gate RECOMPUTED from classification class + action shape (F2) ❌ fabricated pending item BLOCKED — tamper-signal note fires, proposal NOT replayed stored state never trusted the class wins in both directions ◆ FAIL-CLOSED * recomputation wins; the note makes the tamper observable tamper: stored EFFECTIVE, gate True proposal tampered to EFFECTIVE authority-shaped action (gate True) gate RECOMPUTED (F2) class + action still require confirmation ❌ authority by stored state BLOCKED — replayed as PENDING anyway decision still required one verdict via the gateway, never here ◆ FAIL-CLOSED * a tampered EFFECTIVE stamp cannot fabricate authority — the replay keeps the proposal pending duplicate decision event second ClassificationActionDecision same correlation_id, hand-forged idx_events_one_verdict F9 partial unique index (schema v12) ❌ second verdict on the journal REFUSED at the DB — UNIQUE constraint, even for a hand-forged INSERT one proposal, one verdict schema-level, not app-level ◆ FAIL-CLOSED * the F9 migration enforces one-verdict at the schema; the digest never sees a phantom decision duplicate proposal event duplicate ClassificationActionProposed same correlation, hand-forged pending replay (journal-faithful) skips anything with a ratified decision ❌ resurrecting a decided proposal BLOCKED — after one decision the replay yields nothing, duplicate or not digest deterministic identical content_hash across runs ◆ FAIL-CLOSED * duplicates cannot resurrect pending work; the fold hash is stable under all injections VERDICT: all five injections fail closed — corruption observable, gate recomputed, one-verdict schema-enforced, fold deterministic * 0 defects pinned by test_digest_fold_fail_closed_deterministic (commit 156b7ee)
